_meta.purpose: Real published figures for SLATE's lost-document path (documents.report_lost in src/engine/systems/documents.ts leaves a lost licence or passport with status 'lost'; this file gives what replacing it costs and takes in each of SLATE's places), and for a course-exam-card path for boat and pilot credentials.
_meta.conventions: Fees are numbers in the local currency's major unit, with 'currency'. 'confirmed' is true only when the figure was read on the issuing authority's (or the named business's) own page or document during this session. It is false when it came from a search-engine excerpt because the page blocked automated reads (Cloudflare, 403, script-loaded content), and the note says so. null means nothing was found published, and the note says why. Nothing here is invented.
_meta.fitsExisting: SLATE's PersonDocument already has status 'lost', appliedAt, readyAt and issuedAt; a replacement maps to a new pending document with readyAt = appliedAt + cardDays, and where 'interim' is true a document valid for driving from appliedAt. Passport replacement facts already live in content/passports.ts as each PassportRule's 'lost' JSON string; passportReplacement below rechecks them.

licenceReplacement.authority: New York State Department of Motor Vehicles
licenceReplacement.feeNote: Free if the licence was stolen or lost because of a crime and the applicant has form MV-78B, which is available only from police agencies, not the DMV.
methods: in person at a DMV office (form MV-44)
licenceReplacement.cardDaysNote: The DMV's mailing-status page says 'Allow 3 weeks to receive the document.' (A search excerpt of an older version said 2 weeks.)
licenceReplacement.interimNote: The transaction produces an interim license/permit/ID document carrying the State seal, a barcode, the transaction ID and credential information. A search excerpt of dmv.ny.gov's renewal page says the temporary document is valid for 60 days; that 60-day figure was not read on a fetched page.
licenceReplacement.driveMeanwhileNote: Inferred from the interim license being issued as the credential until the card arrives; the fetched pages don't say it in words.
licenceReplacement.policeReport: Not required. Only needed (as form MV-78B) to get the replacement free after a crime.

licenceReplacement.feeNote: Class C replacement, read on the DMV's licensing-fees page (no effective date shown). Commercial classes cost more ($44 per search excerpts, not read). A 2022 DMV post on X gave $30, an older figure.
methods: online (DL replacement request; regular non-commercial licences only)
in person at a DMV office (form DL 44): fee, photo validation and thumbprint scan
licenceReplacement.cardDaysNote: 'You should receive your new card in the mail within three to four weeks.' Check status online after 60 days.
licenceReplacement.interimNote: The replacement page and the handbook's replacement section don't mention an interim licence. The handbook gives a 60-day temporary licence after a passed drive test and after an in-office renewal; whether an office replacement gets one isn't stated.
licenceReplacement.driveMeanwhileNote: Not stated. The handbook says that once the replacement card arrives the old card is no longer valid, so a found old card works until then.
licenceReplacement.policeReport: Not mentioned on the DMV's pages.

licenceReplacement.feeNote: DMV express offices (some AAA branches, Nutmeg State Financial Credit Union) may add a convenience fee of up to $8.
methods: by mail (form B-350, $30 check or money order to 60 State Street, Wethersfield)
licenceReplacement.cardDaysNote: Online or in person: 'within 30 days'. By mail: 'within 20 days' (the page's own figures).
licenceReplacement.interimNote: In person: 'You will get a temporary license at your appointment.' No interim is mentioned for online or mail requests.
licenceReplacement.driveMeanwhileNote: With the temporary licence from an in-person appointment. Online/mail applicants have nothing to show until the card comes.

licenceReplacement.authority: Ontario Ministry of Transportation, through ServiceOntario
methods: in person at a ServiceOntario centre (required when in Ontario)
online, mail or fax to the Ministry only when outside Ontario
licenceReplacement.cardDaysNote: In person: new licence by mail 'within four to six weeks'. Outside Ontario: a one-time temporary licence mailed in 1-2 weeks if away under 6 months; a replacement card in 4-6 weeks if away longer.
licenceReplacement.interimNote: The clerk gives a temporary driver's licence on the spot.
licenceReplacement.policeReport: Advised, not a condition: 'If your driver's licence is lost or stolen, immediately contact your local police department and file a police report.'
licenceReplacement.payment: Cheque, money order, Visa or Mastercard; not American Express.

licenceReplacement.feeNote: Set by the Motor Vehicle Fees Regulation (B.C. Reg. 334/91), Schedule item 4(a)(iv): 'For a duplicate of a driver's licence, other than a learner's licence: $17'.
methods: in person at a driver licensing office, with two pieces of accepted ID and a new photo
licenceReplacement.methodsNote: No online replacement yet. Motor Vehicle Act amendments announced 2026-02-19 would allow online replacement of a valid lost, destroyed or damaged licence; the province expects the service 'to begin operating in 2027'.
licenceReplacement.cardDaysNote: Card mailed 'within two weeks' per secondary guides; ICBC's replacement page loads its text by script and could not be read.
licenceReplacement.interimNote: ICBC issues an interim (paper) driver's licence valid for 90 days when a licence is obtained or renewed, and calls it 'a valid driving licence'; a further 90-day interim can be issued if the card is delayed. That it is issued on a replacement too comes from secondary guides.
licenceReplacement.confirmedNote: Fee, interim rule and online-replacement plan confirmed on primary pages; the 2-week mailing time is not.

licenceReplacement.authority: Secretaría de Movilidad (SEMOVI); fee set by Código Fiscal de la Ciudad de México art. 229, collected by the Secretaría de Administración y Finanzas
licenceReplacement.feeNote: Art. 229 fr. VII: a replacement (reposición) costs the same as issue and 'conservarán la vigencia de la licencia en reposición', so it keeps the lost licence's expiry date. 2026 issue/renewal fees: tipo A (particulares) 1,142; tipo A permanente 1,500; A1 (motorcycles) 572; A2 (cars and motorcycles) 1,142. The 1,049 that the city's trámite page shows is the 2025 figure.
methods: generate and pay a línea de captura on the Finanzas site, then attend in person by appointment at a SEMOVI Módulo de Control Vehicular y Licencias
licenceReplacement.cardDaysNote: The card is printed and handed over at the appointment ('entrega al momento', per the city's trámite page in a search excerpt).
licenceReplacement.interimNote: No interim document: the card is issued on the day.
licenceReplacement.driveMeanwhileNote: Not stated. Between the loss and the appointment the driver has no licence to show; whether the acta covers that is not published.
licenceReplacement.policeReport: Required when the physical licence is missing: an acta circunstanciada for loss from a Juzgado Cívico, or for theft an acta de denuncia before the Fiscalía.
licenceReplacement.confirmedNote: Fee read from the Tesorería's 2026 tariff sheet. Requirements and same-day delivery come from search excerpts of cdmx.gob.mx trámite pages, which didn't load for automated reads.

methods: by phone (photocard holders whose details haven't changed, not expiring within 56 days)
by post (form D1 for car and motorbike, from most Post Offices)
licenceReplacement.cardDaysNote: Online: 'should arrive within a week'. By post: 'should arrive in 3 weeks', longer if medical or personal details need checking.
licenceReplacement.driveMeanwhileNote: The entitlement to drive is held on DVLA's record, not in the card (Road Traffic Act 1988 s.87). A driver who can't produce a licence when a constable asks has a defence by producing it at a police station within 7 days (s.164(8)). This legal reading comes from secondary guides, not the GOV.UK page.
licenceReplacement.policeReport: 'You should contact the police if your driving licence is stolen.' Not a condition of the application.
licenceReplacement.foundLater: A licence found after applying must be returned to DVLA, Swansea SA99 1AB.
licenceReplacement.eligibility: Resident of Great Britain, not disqualified. Northern Ireland has its own service.

licenceReplacement.authority: National Driver Licence Service (NDLS), for the Road Safety Authority
licenceReplacement.feeNote: The €35 also applies to drivers over 70 when the licence is lost or damaged, although over-70 renewals are free.
methods: online (Public Services Card and verified MyGovID)
in person at an NDLS centre by appointment only (no walk-ins)
licenceReplacement.cardDaysNote: Secondary guides give 5-9 working days to process plus 2-5 days by post, so up to about two weeks. NDLS's own pages are behind a Cloudflare check and could not be read.
licenceReplacement.interimNote: None found. The replacement is a copy of the original, valid for the same period and with the same codes.
licenceReplacement.driveMeanwhileNote: Per secondary guides: a driver stopped without the licence must produce it at a Garda station within 10 days. Professional drivers get 15 days' grace after applying for a replacement. Not read on a primary page.
licenceReplacement.policeReport: Required: a completed Garda Declaration Form, online or in person.
licenceReplacement.confirmedNote: Fee, methods and Garda declaration were read on Citizens Information, the state's information board; NDLS blocked automated reads (Cloudflare). Card time and the 10-day rule are not confirmed.

passportReplacement.feeNote: Reporting the loss (Form DS-64) is free. In the U.S. the replacement is a new application in person on Form DS-11: $130 application fee plus $35 acceptance fee. Matches content/passports.ts.
passportReplacement.daysNote: Routine 4-6 weeks, expedited 2-3 weeks, from receipt (search excerpt of travel.state.gov). Matches passports.ts (42 days; expedite 21).
passportReplacement.oldCancelledNote: An online DS-64 report cancels the passport within 1 business day, and it stays invalid if found.
passportReplacement.confirmedNote: travel.state.gov returned nothing to automated reads; these come from search excerpts and agree with what passports.ts read from the Department's fee chart PDF on 2026-09-29.

passportReplacement.issuer: Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (Passport Program)
passportReplacement.feeNote: An 'extra $45 fee for replacing a lost or stolen passport', paid on top of the regular passport fee (163.50 for a 10-year adult in Canada per passports.ts), so 208.50 in total. A declaration (form PPTC 203) goes with the application. Matches passports.ts.
passportReplacement.daysNote: In person in Canada: standard pickup on or after 10 business days, express pickup 2-9 business days (search excerpt of canada.ca). By mail from the US or abroad: 20 business days plus mailing. IRCC may investigate the loss before issuing, which can delay it. passports.ts has 28 days for the standard route; check which channel SLATE models.
passportReplacement.oldCancelledNote: The page calls the lost passport 'still valid' only to explain why the declaration is needed. A document reported lost or stolen is no longer valid for travel, and one found later 'should' be returned.
passportReplacement.policeReport: Not required. Call 1-800-567-6868 (or the nearest Government of Canada office abroad) as soon as possible.

passportReplacement.feeNote: 'It costs £102 to renew or replace your passport if you apply online or £115.50 if you fill in a paper form.' A lost or stolen passport must be cancelled first, and someone must confirm the applicant's identity online. 1 Week Fast Track for a replacement costs £192 (adult); Online Premium (1 day) can't be used to replace a lost passport. Matches passports.ts.
passportReplacement.daysNote: 'You'll usually get your passport within 3 weeks', longer if HMPO needs more information or an interview. A search excerpt said to allow 'at least six weeks' for a lost or stolen passport, but no current GOV.UK page read today says that. passports.ts has 21 days.
passportReplacement.policeReport: Not required by GOV.UK; cancellation is done online with HMPO.

passportReplacement.issuer: Department of Foreign Affairs, Passport Service
passportReplacement.feeNote: There is no separate lost-passport fee: the standard €75 Passport Online adult fee (Post Passport €80 plus €9.50 postage; +€15 postage if resident outside Ireland). Matches passports.ts.
passportReplacement.daysNote: A lost or stolen passport is a 'Complex Adult Renewal', with a current average of 15 working days (about 21 calendar days) online, not counting postage. Passport Assist (phone, paper) averages 6 weeks, and paper applications in general an estimated 6 weeks. passports.ts carries 28 days as the general figure; its lost note already says 15 working days.
passportReplacement.oldCancelledNote: Reported to Interpol; 'no longer valid for travel'; do not travel on it if found. Losing two or more in 10 years can limit the next passport to 1-10 years.
passportReplacement.policeReport: Not needed when applying for a replacement, since the loss is reported in the application. Reporting a loss without applying needs a Garda certificate of loss and a signed letter.

passportReplacement.feeNote: No separate replacement fee: a new passport at the ordinary derecho for the chosen validity (10 years 4,280 in 2026; 6 years 2,440; 3 years 1,795). Matches passports.ts.
passportReplacement.daysNote: Issued at the appointment, in about one to two hours (SRE consular pages, search excerpts). Matches passports.ts (0 days).
passportReplacement.oldCancelledNote: Not stated on a page that could be read; passports.ts also has null.
passportReplacement.policeReport: Required: the original report of the loss or theft made before the Ministerio Público or competent authority (search excerpts of SRE embassy pages).
passportReplacement.confirmedNote: SRE pages sit behind a Radware bot check. The requirements and same-day issue come from search excerpts of sre.gob.mx pages; the fee is passports.ts's own, read from the Ley Federal de Derechos.

boating.credential: New York State Boating Safety Certificate (Brianna's Law)
boating.authority: New York State Office of Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation
boating.requiredFor: Every operator of a motorized vessel, including PWCs, regardless of age, from 2025-01-01. Minimum age to take the course: 10.
boating.course: Classroom: at least 8 hours with a certified NYS instructor (some volunteer instructors charge nothing). Online: state-approved providers, remote, with a mandatory exam.
boating.courseFeeProvider: Boat-Ed (Kalkomey), New York course; the certificate fee is included in the online price
boating.exam: Final exam at the end of the course. Boat-Ed: unit quizzes 70%, final exam 80%, unlimited attempts.
boating.passMarkNote: The 80% is Boat-Ed's published bar for its approved course. NYS Parks' page doesn't publish a pass mark.
boating.cardFeeNote: $10 permanent certificate fee for classroom students 18 and older, paid after the course; under-18s don't pay it. Online provider fees include it.
boating.interim: A temporary certificate valid for 90 days until the permanent one arrives by mail (NYS Parks). Boat-Ed says its printable temporary is valid 60 days and the permanent one comes in 3-5 weeks.
boating.validity: Lifetime. The original physical certificate must be carried on board.

boating.authority: California State Parks, Division of Boating and Waterways (DBW)
boating.requiredFor: Every operator of a motorized vessel, regardless of age, from 2025-01-01, after a phase-in by age from 2018. Nobody under 16 may operate a boat with a motor over 15 hp (limited exceptions).
boating.course: A NASBLA/state-approved boating safety course and exam, then an application to DBW with proof of education and payment. Boat-Ed says most students finish in 3-4 hours.
boating.courseFeeProvider: Boat-Ed (Kalkomey), California course; the $10 state fee is separate
boating.exam: Boat-Ed: final exam 80%, unit quizzes 70%, unlimited attempts.
boating.passMarkNote: The provider's published bar. DBW doesn't publish a pass mark on the card site.
boating.interim: A 90-day temporary boater card by email once DBW has the application, proof and payment.
boating.cardDaysNote: Official card by mail 'within 30 days from the time the application was approved'.

boating.credential: Connecticut Safe Boating Certificate (SBC); a Certificate of Personal Watercraft Operation (CPWO) for PWCs
boating.authority: Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection (DEEP), Boating Division
boating.course: An approved course of at least 8 hours. Self-paced online courses are not approved; instructor-led virtual classes of 8+ hours with a proctored exam are accepted.
boating.courseFeeProvider: Landfall Navigation, 2026 Connecticut Safe Boating Course (8 hours over Zoom, one day or two evenings); the state's $50 isn't mentioned as included. Search excerpts give $60-70 for Coast Guard Auxiliary flotillas and $75 for Safe Boating America (not read).
boating.exam: Proctored exam at the end of the course. Equivalency exam without the course: $75.
boating.passMarkNote: DEEP: 'A score of 80% or better is required to pass.'
boating.cardFeeNote: One-time $50 for the certificate, bought and printed through DEEP's Online Sportsmen Licensing System about a week after the course is reported.
boating.interim: A temporary certificate exists for new boat registrants: valid three months from registering the boat with DMV, one per person while completing certification.
boating.cardDaysNote: Self-printed online roughly a week after the course is recorded; no mailed card.
boating.validity: Not stated on the pages read.

boating.authority: Transport Canada, Office of Boating Safety, through accredited course providers
boating.requiredFor: Every operator of a motorized pleasure craft in Canada, except in the Northwest Territories and Nunavut.
boating.course: An accredited course. For internet testing, the online study guide must take no less than 3 hours (TP 15080). A test can't be challenged online without a course; a challenge test is written in person under an accredited provider's supervision.
boating.courseFeeProvider: BOATsmart! (Transport Canada accredited): course, test and card, $49.95 per boater; group discounts up to 35%
boating.exam: BOATsmart: 50 multiple-choice questions, 38 correct to pass; retries once every 24 hours, unlimited.
boating.passMarkNote: TP 15080: 'the passing grade of the test shall be 75%'. Search excerpts of Transport Canada pages say 36 questions per test; BOATsmart's own test has 50.
boating.cardFeeNote: No separate government fee: 'All fees for courses, tests, and card replacement services are established by course providers.' Replacement is through the provider that issued the card.
boating.interim: A temporary PCOC printable at once, valid until the permanent card arrives or 60 days after the test at most (TP 15080).
boating.cardDaysNote: BOATsmart: the card arrives by mail within 4 weeks.

boating.credential: RYA Powerboat Level 2 certificate (the basis of the International Certificate of Competence)
boating.authority: Royal Yachting Association, through RYA recognized training centres
boating.requiredFor: Not a legal requirement for UK leisure boating; it is the usual proof of competence, and the route to the ICC that charter companies and some foreign waters ask for.
boating.course: 2 days, practical: low-speed close-quarters handling, man-overboard recovery, driving at planing speed, collision regulations. No prerequisites. Minimum age 12; holders aged 12-16 get a certificate endorsed for use under adult supervision (age from search excerpts of the RYA's course page).
boating.courseFeeProvider: UKSA, West Cowes, Isle of Wight: from £290 course-only, £330 residential, 3:1 ratio, ICC add-on paid to the RYA. Hamble River Sailing Club: £295 non-members, £240 members (updated 2026-05-12). Search excerpts give Urban Truant (Hamble Point) £350 and Hamble Point Sailing School £275-300 for Level 1 & 2 (not read; the school's site returned 403).
boating.exam: Continuous practical assessment by the instructor; no written exam.
boating.cardFeeNote: The certificate is included. The ICC is a separate fee paid to the RYA, not found.

boating.authority: Irish Sailing, through accredited training centres
boating.requiredFor: Not generally required by law for recreational powerboats; it is Ireland's standard competence certificate and the route to the ICC.
boating.course: 2 days, 9:30-17:00: docking, mooring, anchoring, confined-space handling, person-overboard recovery, rules of the road, trailer launch and recovery, knots; boats from 15 hp tillers to 175 hp RIBs. Minimum age 16.
boating.courseFeeProvider: Irish National Sailing & Powerboat School, Dún Laoghaire: €360 (course C32, 4-5 June 2026); most of its 2026 dates are €365 per search excerpts. Quest Howth €335 and Safe Water Training (Galway/Mayo) €395, per search excerpts.
boating.cardFeeNote: Included in the course; ICC upgrade fee not found.
boating.confirmedNote: The INSS €360 was read; the other centres' prices and the 'not required by law' point are from search excerpts.

knowledgeTest.validationQuestionsNote: Unscored validation questions may be added; the listed number excludes them.
knowledgeTest.passMarkNote: FAA Airman Knowledge Testing Matrix, revised 2026-09-25: 'PAR Private Pilot Airplane 60 15 2.0 70'. A retest after failure needs an instructor's endorsement, or a 30-day wait without one.
knowledgeTest.feeProvider: PSI Services, the FAA's contracted testing vendor: '$175.00 per voucher (plus applicable tax)', valid one year.
knowledgeTest.passRateNote: FAA's 2025 Airman Knowledge Tests report: Private Pilot Airplane 44,657 tests, 89.56% pass, 81.64 average. 2024: 91.90% of 46,132 (search excerpt of the FAA 2024 report). These count every attempt.
knowledgeTest.firstTimePassRateNote: The FAA doesn't publish first-time knowledge-test pass rates; its reports don't separate first attempts from retakes.

practicalTest.examinerFeeNote: The FAA sets no fee and no cap; each Designated Pilot Examiner prices independently. Published fees from named DPEs: Mike Gwinn (KLWB, Lewisburg WV) $700 for an initial private ASEL/ASES/AMEL ride, retest 50% plus travel; Todd Haifley $900-1,000 depending on location, $200-500 for a flight-only retest after another examiner's disapproval; Brandon Ayers (KGLE, Gainesville TX) $1,200 cash, $500 flight-only retest. A DPE-written article (Daytona DPE, 2026-07-23) puts 2026 initial checkrides at $600-1,200 but cites no survey. No published survey was found.
practicalTest.passRateNote: FAA U.S. Civil Airmen Statistics 2025, Table 19 (original certificates approved/disapproved by conductor), Private: examiners approved 28,765 and disapproved 9,553 of 38,318 (75.07%); FAA inspectors 53 of 70 (75.71%). Table 20 (additional ratings), Private: 81.53% with examiners. These count every practical test, retakes included.
practicalTest.firstTimePassRateNote: The FAA doesn't publish first-time practical-test pass rates. A flight-training commentator (jasonblair.net) models the 2025 private pilot first-time rate at 66-68%; that is an estimate, not FAA data.

notes: Blocked pages: NDLS and RSA (Cloudflare), ICBC's replacement page (script-loaded), travel.state.gov (no content), SRE embassy pages (Radware), cdmx.gob.mx trámite pages (connection reset), Hamble Point Sailing School (403). Every figure taken from a search excerpt because of this says so.

Who issues a temporary document while the card is mailed: NY (interim document), CT (in person only), Ontario (in person), BC (90-day interim). DVLA and NDLS issue none, but driving goes on under the record entitlement with a produce-within-days rule. CA's replacement page doesn't say. CDMX prints the card at the appointment.

Police reports: required in Mexico City (acta from a Juzgado Cívico for loss, a Fiscalía denuncia for theft) and Ireland (Garda Declaration Form). Advised, not required, in Ontario and Great Britain. In NY only the MV-78B, which makes a crime-related replacement free.

A Mexico City replacement keeps the expiry date of the licence it replaces (Código Fiscal CDMX art. 229 fr. VII). The other places' pages don't say whether a replacement card keeps the old expiry. In Ireland the replacement is 'valid for the same period' (Citizens Information).

Passport check against content/passports.ts: fees agree for all five. Times worth rechecking: Ireland's lost-passport route is a complex renewal at 15 working days, against 28 days in the general field (its lost note already says 15). Canada's in-person standard is 10 business days, against 28 days. A '6 weeks for lost or stolen' UK figure appeared only in a search excerpt and wasn't found on a current GOV.UK page.
Boat course pass marks of 80% (NY, CA) are the provider Boat-Ed's published bar; NYS Parks and DBW don't publish a pass mark. CT's 80% is DEEP's own. Canada's 75% is in Transport Canada's TP 15080.
FAA practical-test figures are the FAA's own approved/disapproved counts for 2025 and include retakes; no first-time figure is published for either test.
